facts.text: createdb() checks have_createdb_privilege(); the superuser created by initdb has OID 10
template1 has OID 1 and lives in base/1; template0 is base/4, postgres is base/5
createdb() locks the template with ShareLock through get_db_info()
CountOtherDBBackends() makes createdb fail while other sessions use the template
GetNewOidWithIndex() picks the OID; user objects start at FirstNormalObjectId, 16384
pg_database is a shared catalog stored in global/1262
check_db_file_conflict() is false when no directory exists for the OID
since PG 15 the default strategy is WAL_LOG; FILE_COPY needs 2 checkpoints
CreateDirAndVersionFile creates base/<OID> with a PG_VERSION file holding 17
ScanSourceDatabasePgClass reads pg_class of the template, stored as base/1/1259
RelationCopyStorageUsingBuffer WAL-logs every copied page with log_newpage_buffer
PreventInTransactionBlock makes CREATE DATABASE fail inside BEGIN
_fsm and _vm are the free-space and visibility map forks of a relation
files 112, 113 and 1247 in base/1 are catalog tables and indexes
